text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: âHoryaaaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —YAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Rickey...! Acute-san...!!
Falco-san...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(From the closest distance possible!!
I'll burn my brilliance into all of you!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae!! It's Hokko Tarumae!! Hokko Tarumae takes the lead!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!! A monumental feat is achieved!!
The most G1 victories in history!! History is made!!
A legend has been born right here, right now—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Residents
text_block_list.text:
She did it she did it she did it—!!
Tarumae-chan won!!
She wooooon—!!

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan... you're truly magnificent...!
Our star shines so brilliantly...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I won.........
I beat... Falco-san... in the Tokyo Daishoten...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaay!!!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae-e-e!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Aaargh, total and utter defeat!! Huge congratulations, Tarumae!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Rickey... thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm the one who should thank you☆
Because during the race, I saw it!
A sign like never before...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is a future where we bring out the best in each other,
elevating ourselves to limitless heights...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae!
I'm going to challenge you again!
Let's run together as many times as it takes!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because that will surely become a path of light
and break through our limits!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Is this supposed to be your challenge to me, Ricky?
Heh, bring it on.
I'll take you on as many times as it takes!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: “—Tarumae-chan, congratulations. You're a true... champion, aren't you?”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...It was because you were always running ahead of me,
Acute-san, that I was able to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Truly... thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
You're very welcome~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "...Guess I'll have to keep competing with Tarumae-chan for a long time yet."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Since Ricky-chan came all this way too,
it'd be a waste not to have even more fun...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Let's keep running together, on and on!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Because we are the brilliance born from the dirt!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Tarumae-chan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
You were so dazzling, so sparkly,
and just absolutely, unfathomaaaably brilliant!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Falco-san—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to run like this today with everyone, and with Tarumae-chan...
I was truly so happy! I'm overjoyed!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so, so much—
for letting me shine on the dirt once again!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, it's me who should be...
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Because Falco-san was there for me,
I'm sure I...—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then...
right at this moment, we're even ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “—Tarumae-chan. The truth is, there's something I want to entrust to you.”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Something you want to entrust to me...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The thing I could never achieve—
a victory in an international GⅠ race in Dubai for dirt Umamusume, that's what☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...How about it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That's just—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Isn't the answer already obvious?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I promise I will carry on Falco-san's feelings.
And then――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'll deliver the brilliance of Japanese dirt racing and Tomakomai to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you, Tarumae-chan.
I love you!☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaaann!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...So that was it after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —I'm home, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Hokko Tarumae!!
Tarumae is the undisputed dirt champion!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were shining out thereーー!!!
Thank you for the best race everーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!!
Thank you for cheering me on!!
Once again—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The star born in Tomakomai!!
A migratory bird with paper wings!!
I'm Hokko Tarumae!!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The reason I can stand here today is all thanks to everyone who cheered for me, and to those who raised me—!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A "hometown," and—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to every single one of the amazing dirt Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to support me!! Dirt racing!! And Tomakomai!!
From now on as well—
Thank you so much!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The cheers celebrating Hokko Tarumae echoed long into the skies over Oi Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a short time passed...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And now, we've arrived at the final live performance
of Hokko Tarumae's 'URA Best Dirt Umamusume' commemorative event!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"It might be a bit late to ask, but since it's a URA award,
why is the commemorative event at Oi Racecourse?
Oi counts as a regional track, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, isn't that a little too obvious by now?! It's clearly
because Tarumae hyped up the dirt scene this year,
JRA and NAR alike!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: For this special occasion, we have a special live performance featuring Smart Falcon herself!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so, so very much
for gathering here today just for me!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Let's make this the best live ever
and celebrate Tarumae-chan together☆
Are you all ready~!?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Tarumae & Falco
text_block_list.text: Music, start!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so began a concert that would be told as a legend for generations to come."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And...
Hokko Tarumae's radiance
spreads its wings toward even further horizons—
